body: **Verification:** Retested on Production. Prospect is Unsubscribed in Saleshandy trigger, Create a Lead in Pipedrive activity, prospect unsubscribes through the link. When the prospect is not in Pipedrive, the person is created with one lead and one deal titled with the prospect's email and one activity. When the person exists with no deal, a new lead is added to that person. On the first run for the new prospect, the person had no lead after 90 seconds. The rerun with a new prospect passed.
waitingFor: QA to send from npm run jira. Source: production smoke run 2026-10-29, account emailopenedprod, sequence 985157, Pipedrive saleshandy.pipedrive.com. QA approved the wording in chat.
